day_line: A candle flame on a Goat day. Warm and gentle: good for family time and kind words, easy to over-give.

lines.Yang Wood: Your words land softly today. Call your parents and listen more than you talk.
lines.Yin Wood: Sunday feels sweet today. Bake, garden or doodle; keep it just for you.
lines.Yang Fire: Someone wants the remote too. Let them pick the show; you pick dinner.
lines.Yin Fire: Your people gather close today. Host tea at home; store-bought cake is fine.
lines.Yang Earth: You get looked after today. Say yes to the lunch invite and bring fruit.
lines.Yin Earth: A calm thought settles today. Plan next week in ten minutes, then stop.
lines.Yang Metal: A favour comes back to you today. Enjoy it; no need to keep score.
lines.Yin Metal: Sunday chores pile up today. Do the worst one first, then take a walk.
lines.Yang Water: Easy on the wallet today. Cook a big pot and freeze half.
lines.Yin Water: A small chance opens today. Reply to the invite; you'll be glad you went.

group_tips.clash: Go easy today. Skip the debate and keep plans simple.
group_tips.friction: Small bumps today. Let one comment slide and smile.
group_tips.steady: A calm, normal Sunday. Do one chore, then rest.
group_tips.best: Your day to shine. Host lunch or call the family.

caption:
Born in an Ox year? Today is a Goat day, so go easy. Drop your animal below 👇

Every day has an animal, and it meets the animal of the year you were born. Ox and Goat sit opposite, so today asks Ox people for patience; Rabbit, Horse and Pig get along with the Goat and have an easy day; Rat feels a little friction.

Your animal is your Season. Your element is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Which group are you in today? Comment your animal.
